$comment: The parts being rewritten block by block (DEC-79), read by scripts/verify/legacy-zones.ts. legacy: the old code (except: paths inside it that stay). next: where the new code goes; it never imports the old code (transitive: not even through other files; oldOnly: files outside the old code that new code may not use either). importers: the production files outside the zone that import the old code today, the seam list of the rewrite; it only gets shorter, and the zone is removed when its old code is deleted. Print the current importers with: node scripts/verify/legacy-zones.ts --print This file is a guarded path: the task card of a change that edits it must already be on main and list scripts/verify/legacy-zones.json.
